name: Bacterial reverse mutation test (Ames, OECD TG 471)
description: Revertant counts by strain, metabolic activation and concentration against the concurrent and historical controls; the call is the Study Director's.

name: Bioanalytical method validation (chromatographic, ICH M10)
description: Full validation of a chromatographic bioanalytical method against ICH M10 section 3: calibration, accuracy and precision, selectivity, matrix effect, carry-over, dilution integrity and stability.

name: Dose range-finding / MTD study
description: Short parallel-group study for dose selection: group comparisons, clinical-sign and mortality incidence, M3(R2) 1.5 high-dose facts; MTD and recommended doses by the Study Director.

name: hERG (IKr) patch clamp concentration-response with safety margin
description: Concentration-response of hERG current inhibition per ICH E14/S7B Q&A 2.1; IC50 with CI, Hill slope, and free-exposure margin per S7B Q&A 1.2.

name: In vitro potency and selectivity (4PL)
description: Concentration-response potency at the primary target and off-targets by 4PL, with reference-compound checks and relative potency.

name: Single-dose pharmacokinetics in a test species (NCA)
description: Single-dose PK by non-compartmental analysis: Cmax, AUC, terminal phase selected by the scientist, t1/2, AUCinf, CL, Vz, Vss and absolute bioavailability.

name: In vivo QT telemetry (ICH S7B; S7A cardiovascular)
description: Conscious telemetry crossover: QT corrected by a justified method, change from baseline and from vehicle with CIs, exposure coverage; QTc and cardiovascular conclusions by the Study Director.

name: Liver microsomal metabolic stability (substrate depletion) with IVIVE
description: In vitro half-life by parent depletion in liver microsomes across species; CLint,app and well-stirred predicted hepatic clearance.

name: Peptide stability in blood, serum or plasma
description: Depletion of intact peptide in stated blood, serum or plasma conditions; half-life with 95% CI by the protocol's model, censoring beyond the last sample, and a plateau check for incomplete degradation.

name: Plasma protein binding by equilibrium dialysis
description: Fraction unbound in plasma across species by equilibrium dialysis, with the ICH M12 positive-control rule and the fu < 1% reliability flag.

name: Repeat-dose toxicity with Dunnett comparison to control
description: Group design checked against OECD TG 407/408/409 and ICH M3(R2); per-endpoint Dunnett comparisons; NOAEL set by the Study Director.

name: Safety pharmacology: central nervous system (ICH S7A 2.7.1)
description: Functional observation battery / modified Irwin covering the five S7A 2.7.1 domains; incidence by dose, sex and time; adverse CNS effect by the Study Director.

name: Safety pharmacology: respiratory system (ICH S7A 2.7.3)
description: Respiratory rate with tidal volume and/or oxygen saturation, minute volume derived, each dose compared with vehicle at each timepoint; adverse effect by the Study Director.

name: Toxicokinetics in a toxicity study (ICH S3A)
description: Systemic exposure per dose, sex and day within a toxicity study: non-compartmental Cmax and AUC, dose proportionality by the power model, observed exposure ratios between days, and incurred-sample reanalysis.
